The '''Esraza Temple''' was located on the celestial body [[Oligtaz]] in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It was known to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[10,000 BBY]]. Early explorers described the structure as a reality-warping nexus that granted visitors the abilities of teleportation and farseeing. Eventually, the Esraza Temple was included in the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]]&mdash;a list of spectactular, antique artificial objects that the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Vicendi]] compiled in 10,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] for the publication ''[[Arturum Galactinum]]''.<ref name="TEA" />

At one point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Esraza Temple was replicated in the [[environment room]]&mdash;which was used to host detailed reproductions of exotic locales&mdash;aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] while it was voyaging along<ref name="Riders">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Riders" /> By [[43 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of the Esraza Temple, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the temple lay in ruins, and researchers hypothesized that the structure had been situated above a [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] of [[lumni-spice]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Esraza Temple was first mentioned in [[Ray Winninger]]'s [[1989]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']].<ref name="Riders" />
